parameters.query:
-- One round trip: counts, a formatted open-items summary, and
-- which message (if any) is worth sending, all in one row.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT tasks, synced_at FROM pb.daily_snapshot WHERE id = 1
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT tasks FROM s), '[]'::jsonb) AS tasks,
    COALESCE((SELECT synced_at::date = CURRENT_DATE FROM s), FALSE) AS is_fresh
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jsonb_array_elements(tasks) t
     WHERE (t->>'dailyDone')::boolean) AS done_count,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jsonb_array_elements(tasks) t
     WHERE NOT (t->>'dailyDone')::boolean) AS open_count,
  (SELECT string_agg(
      '#' || (t->>'num') || ' ' || (t->>'label') ||
      CASE
        WHEN (t->>'severity')::int = 1 AND (t->>'due') = to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD')
          THEN ' (urgent, due today)'
        WHEN (t->>'severity')::int = 1
          THEN ' (urgent)'
        WHEN (t->>'due') = to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD')
          THEN ' (due today)'
        ELSE ''
      END,
      ', ')
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(tasks) t
   WHERE NOT (t->>'dailyDone')::boolean) AS open_summary,
  CASE
    WHEN is_fresh AND jsonb_array_length(tasks) > 0
         AND (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jsonb_array_elements(tasks) t
                WHERE NOT (t->>'dailyDone')::boolean) > 0
      THEN 'digest'
    WHEN (NOT is_fresh OR jsonb_array_length(tasks) = 0)
         AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Vilnius') = 9
      THEN 'remind_to_plan'
    ELSE ''
  END AS nudge_kind
FROM base;
